purpose: P1 consistency fixture for the dsh-native Zig harness: the assistant finishes with max_tokens. The message is committed with usage, the partial tool-call block is not executed, step returns max-tokens, and turn/end reason is max-tokens. Pins design B11.

groundTruthV4.note: Real SDK snapshot. First turn: prompt, assistant message with text and a truncated tool-call block in the stream, usage, finish(max-tokens), step/end, turn/end max-tokens. The source continues with a second turn at 18-25; this fixture stops after the first turn.

rules.rule: When the provider finish is max-tokens, the assistant/message is committed, the tool call is not executed, step returns max-tokens, and turn/end reason is max-tokens.
The usage chunk is folded into assistant/message.data.usage and kept in the stream. inputTokens/outputTokens are semantic values, not volatile fields.
The stream opens a tool-call block and emits a truncated tool-call-chunks run but no block-end. The block is not in message.content and no tool/call event is emitted.
step/end precedes turn/end; turn/end reason is max-tokens. max-tokens is sticky across later steps.
The source snapshot continues with a second turn (18-25). This fixture stops after the first turn to pin B11 only.

openIssues: usage values 12/4 are authored neutral numbers, not provider-measured token counts. They are semantic for the fixture but must not be used as real accounting evidence.
The Zig harness must fold the usage chunk into assistant/message.data.usage and keep the usage chunk in the recorded stream; P0 does not interpret streams yet.

The truncated tool-call block must remain open (no block-end) and must not appear in message.content or produce tool/call events. A stream assembler that materializes partial tool calls would break this fixture.
No jq binary is installed in WSL; the JSONL check uses Python 3.14 plus a Node 24 stdin sentinel (node.exe).

toolSchema.note: Literal read tool schema behind the {{tools}} whole-array token. The expected request/header keeps dsh's committed {{tools}} form; this object records the schema text so it is not silently dropped. A P1 comparator that needs literal schema text must resolve {{tools}} to this schema (plus the runtime tool set).
